topScam.title: The "Digital Arrest" Police Video Call
topScam.scam: A caller in uniform claims your Aadhaar or passport was found in an illegal parcel or money laundering probe. They place you on a fraudulent WhatsApp video call or custom video link with a backdrop resembling a police station, CBI, or ED cyber cell, declaring you are under 'Digital Arrest' and coercing you to transfer savings into a fake 'RBI verification escrow'.
topScam.protection: Indian law and law enforcement agencies have NO legal concept of 'Digital Arrest'. Police, CBI, ED, and customs NEVER conduct interrogations, trials, or arrests over video calls. Hang up immediately, block the number, and report to the National Cybercrime Portal or dial 1930.
topScam.sourceName: I4C & PM Mann Ki Baat Cyber Alert

featuredTool.name: headroom
featuredTool.tagline: Compress tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before they reach the LLM. 20% fewer tokens for coding agents, 60-95% fewer tokens for JSON, same answers. Library, proxy, MCP server.
featuredTool.why_it_matters: Battle-tested in the open — 78.3K GitHub stars from real production users.

realityPick.title: The Token Cost Bleed
realityPick.myth: Per-token prices are dropping 10x every year — don't worry about cost optimization!
realityPick.reality: Agentic tool runs, compiler output dumps, and large git diffs consume millions of tokens in minutes. Automated CI/CD agents burn budgets on whitespace and noisy terminal logs.
realityPick.fix: Strip stack traces, memory addresses, and repetitive logs before tokenization using specialized CLI proxies (RTK) and pre-LLM output compressors (headroom).
realityPick.impact: A rogue coding agent loops overnight on a build failure and consumes ₹1,50,000 in API tokens on a single pull request.
